# Quixun QRS-UT100B: the control transfers recfriio --hdp sends to open the
# board, tune terrestrial channel 19 (509 MHz) and close it again, recorded on
# the board itself (2026-11-11, PLEX's firmware b45d5102). Only what goes out is
# kept: bRequest, wValue, wIndex and wLength, in hexadecimal.
#
# ut100b_test.go reads the GPIO steps and the I2C writes out of this and checks
# that the board sends the same ones in the same order.
